2026-11-21-item-4-console-and-panel.webp | The console and the settings panel as the ImGui library draws them, in ImGui's light style at 960 pixels wide with no device, cut to the two windows and set on a white ground, the console across the top with entered lines dimmed, a refused set in red, a host's warning in orange and the hint of the line being entered under the field, and the panel under it on the page of the settings named render, the selected row banded with its value between the marks of left and right and a setting that waits for the next start saying so.
